name: openclaw-mcp

rawRecord.description: 🦞 MCP server for OpenClaw - secure bridge between Claude.ai and your self-hosted OpenClaw assistant with OAuth2 authentication

AUTH_ENABLED.description: Whether to enable authentication (required for production or remote use).

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins, e.g., https://claude.ai.

OPENCLAW_URL.description: The URL of the OpenClaw gateway server.

MCP_CLIENT_ID.description: The client ID used for MCP authentication.

MCP_ISSUER_URL.description: The public HTTPS URL of the MCP server, required for OAuth metadata when running behind a reverse proxy.

MCP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The client secret used for MCP authentication.

OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN.description: The gateway token used for authentication with OpenClaw.
